title: RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Responsible Business Conduct) Amendment Directions, 2026
description: RBI consolidated recovery conduct standards across banks, NBFCs, and housing finance companies, effective January 1, 2027. Key provisions include mandatory recovery agent certification from IIBF, prohibition of device locking, mandatory borrower compensation policies, restricted calling hours (08:00-19:00), and consolidated code of conduct requirements for all recovery operations.
